name: Northshire class chain: the pendant, the statue and the rest of the valley's chain objects exist (#6757, #6728)
contract: rev_20260930_98_northshire_baseline_restore reverted the valley to the pre-revamp world and deleted the CoA rows it found there. rev_20261003_00_coa_northshire_trainer_interaction.sql repaired that regression for the trainer templates, but the spawns were never restored: on a world database that has applied the restore the class chains point at objects that do not exist. #6757 reports it as 'Defias thugs do not drop the quest item' for Lost Pendant (Sun Cleric quest 200058, the pendant is a chest - guids 7912105/7912106, entry 9301103, item 663319) and #6728 as 'no reaction from Uther's statue' for A Quiet Life (entry 9301105, guid 7912102). rev_20261007_20_coa_northshire_class_chain_spawns.sql republishes the authored rows for the 18 gameobjects at guids 7912100-7912117, the chain NPCs at 9003120-9003129 and their two addons. Expected before the SQL: the CONTROL creature Scorch (9300101) is found, because it is one of the four chain rows that survived, and every one of the chain objects is absent - the pendant cannot be looted and 663319 never reaches the bags. Expected after: each chain object is found next to its authored spot, the statue and the mine-mouth and farmhouse chain NPCs are back, and 663319 reaches the bags. rev_20261007_70_coa_northshire_pendant_and_statue.sql then finishes the two objects the way they were set by hand in game: one Lost Pendant, size 0.3, on the crate at the Defias camp (guid 7912105) and the trail spawn (guid 7912106) deleted, and Uther's Statue as a generic 1.5-size statue on the bank in front of the falls. The count reads here prove the spawn half: exactly one pendant is in the valley at all, and it lights up as the quest object of a Sun Cleric on 200058. The loot actions only open a gameobject the player summoned, so the chest is copied beside the crate to prove the chest's loot path hands over the quest-required 663319 (a quest-required roll, which the core keeps in the player's quest-item slots rather than the ordinary loot list).
